_comment: FIXTURE — Fake mock Google Calendar events for Gate 2A comparison logic validation. Contains NO real Google Calendar event IDs, real calendar IDs, real account emails, real attendee emails, real OAuth tokens, credential paths, or any private external identifiers. All IDs and data are fake placeholders invented for testing only.
_purpose: Exercises all 11 classification values in the dry-run comparison logic. Use with: node scripts/google-calendar-sync-dry-run.mjs --fixture docs/project-control/google-calendar-live-events.fixture.json
_classifications_covered: UPDATE — AI_OS_ID confirmed, non-time field differs (keepmees-ritual-coordinator-planning-weekly)
ADOPTION_REQUIRED — exact title+date match, no AI_OS_ID marker (keepmees-ritual-dev-review-weekly)
DUPLICATE_DETECTED — two events carry same AI_OS_ID (keepmees-ritual-product-design-review-weekly)
CREATE — no live event found (keepmees-ritual-project-control-sync-weekly, keepmees-ritual-monthly-budget-review)
REMOTE_DRIFT — AI_OS_ID confirmed, start time externally changed (keepmees-ritual-monthly-roadmap-reset)
MAPPED_EVENT_MISSING_REMOTELY — fixtureLocalMap entry exists but event absent from live list (keepmees-ritual-monthly-risk-review)
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE — fuzzy title match, no AI_OS_ID marker, blocks Gate 3 apply (keepmees-milestone-phase-gate-review)
NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW — multiple exact title+date matches, no AI_OS_ID markers (keepmees-milestone-launch-readiness-review)
DELETE_CANCEL_CANDIDATE — live managed event whose AI_OS_ID is not in any source record
MISSING_LOCAL_MAPPING — advisory flag on NO_OP/UPDATE where fixtureLocalMap has no entry
